testcase.name: Scenario: View 3D Sketch marking-menu locations and sub-environments: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1984:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: View 3D Sketch marking-menu locations and sub-environments ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the customization dialog is open on the Marking Menu tab in the MCAD Software ✔ And Environment is "2D Sketch" ✔ When the user selects "3D Sketch" in the Environment selector ✔ Then the menu-location layout shows "Bend", "Three Point Arc", "Undo", "Helical Curve", "General Dimension", "Include Geometry" and "Finish 3D Sketch" ✔ And Sub-Environment is "None Selected" ✔ And no customization change is pending ✔ When the user opens the Sub-Environment selector ✔ Then the available choices include "3D Line, 3D Arc", "3D Point", "Equation Curve", "Helical Curve", "Projected Curves" and "Spline" ✔ And "None Selected" remains highlighted ✔ When the user dismisses the selector without choosing an option ✔ Then Environment remains "3D Sketch" ✔ And no customization change is pending
